title: OpenEnv Debuts Largest Open Source RL Environments With 12M Tasks
summary:
Developer Adithya S. Kolavi has released a new dataset on Hugging Face that provides speech recognition training across 102 different languages. The project, called OpenEnv, constitutes the largest open source library of reinforcement learning environments, featuring more than 12 million tasks. This multimodal collection also includes optical character recognition data spanning 1 million document pages in 22 languages.

The tools are hosted on the Hugging Face platform to provide AI researchers with high scale, multilingual resources for multimodal RL training. By making these environments open source, the project allows developers to build and test models using diverse linguistic and visual data.
